name: Typora
author: Abner

versions.release_notes:
- Fix a security vulnerability.
- Fix toolbar cannot be opened in Windows ARM.

- Fix file content live update on external changes sometime fail on macOS.
- Fix img ignore custom height attribute.
- Fix Typora keep rename file extension back to md after user change it.

- Fix export / print when using a different theme for export on macOS.
- Add back some predefined macros for back compatibility.
- Add option to use legacy inline parse rules for back compatibility.
- Fix export / print regression on macOS 13, 14 and 15

- Fix crash on macOS 26.4
- Fix list parsing rules.
- Fix HTML styles when export to PDF.

- Fix a security issue when export / print.
- Fix mermaid kanban text wrapping.

- Fix undo text typing only undo one character.
- Fix text typing issues when inline math is disabled and legacy latex delimiter is enabled.
- Fix trail remaining day counting issue on Windows / macOS.

- Support for macOS 26 Tahoe
  - (macOS 26) Tahoe style icon with dark version and custom colors.
  - (macOS 26) Tahoe style menu.
  - (macOS 26) Fix ui compatibility for macOS 26.
  - (macOS 26) Remove “Window Style” option on macOS 26.
- Re-add "share" action in editor context menu on macOS.
- Other bug fixes.

For Windows Users: Please manually download v1.11.6 from https://typora.io or from button below. Previous 1.11.x versions have bugs that downloading upgrades will fail.
- Fix image download and upgrade download bug.

- Fix print dialog not show for print operations on Windows / Linux.
- Other bug fix.

New Features
- LaTeX Delimiters Support. Added support for \(...\) (inline math) and \[...\] (block math).
- Move Row/Paragraph Up/Down using Alt + ↑ / ↓ to move.
- Mermaid v11.7 Update with new diagram types supported:
  - Radar Chart (radar-beta)
  - Treemap (treemap-beta)
Improvements
- Exported HTML now includes Zenuml CSS only when needed (smaller file size).
- Improved math compatibility when pasting from ChatGPT and AI tools.
- Styles preserved when copying to WeChat Official Accounts.
- “Copy without theme styling” now respects plain text setting.
- Videos dropped into Typora now include the controls attribute.
- Exported images no longer use referrerPolicy='no-referrer' by default.
- Option added to disable emoji autocomplete when typing :.
- Improve UI translations for Slovenian, Chinese, Dutch, Polish, Norwegian Nynorsk, French, Portuguese and Swedish.
Linux Updates
- Replaced old APT key using SHA1 with a new secure one. Follow https://support.typora.io/What's-New-1.11/#linux for more details
- Improved Wayland compatibility. Follow https://support.typora.io/What's-New-1.11/#wayland for more details
Bug Fixes
- Fixed text clipping in PDF exports.
- Fixed Mermaid code not working on macOS 12.
- Fixed --- not rendering properly.
- Prevented unwanted indentation when “Indent first line of paragraph” is enabled.
- Fixed issue where GIFs from clipboard couldn’t be inserted.
- Fixed list paste issues in some cases.
- Fixed missing list bullets after 999+ items.
- Fixed PDF export glitches on macOS.
- Fixed issue where outline filter panel closed unexpectedly after scroll.
- Zoom setting with mouse wheel now preserved.
- Fixed rendering issues for certain code blocks with url mode.
- Fix sort naturally in files sidebar.

1. Support math expressions pasted from ChatGPT or other AI services.
2. Fix linux installer on older Debian system.
3. Fix pickiest not displayed in some languages.
4. Fix image not inserted after confirm dialog is shown.
5. Fix PDF export when custom margin is set.
6. Fix checkbox for Articles and File Tree under View menu is not exclusive.
7. Other Bug fixes.

- Fix rename on file tree side bar.
- Fix learned misspelled word not remained after restart.

verification.label: Hashes copied from upstream package manifests (winget-pkgs, Homebrew cask). Not independently re-computed; signatures not checked. Linux (Flatpak) installs come from Flathub, whose repository is signed; Flathub publishes no file checksum.
